summary: Cut about 500 words, mostly by removing whole optional sentences and short paragraphs: narrative repetitions, the drive, the second-thought details of the staged-rescue explanation, the footstep, and descriptive redundancies. All eight protected excerpts and every essential plot function are kept. The ending is intact. My estimate is about 1000 words, but this has not been measured.
